G2 checks every binding_change line of laws/STATEMENT_DIFF.jsonl against the bound kernel forms at its bound_commit, which needs the git history. tests/_util.copy_repo copies the tree without .git. So on the copy G2 fails at lines 261-263, 'a copied tree cannot check it', whatever the tree holds. A run of this command on a copy of the I93-fixed tree fails G2 alone, and the same command on the checkout passes all six checks (2362 s). The gate writes nothing to the tree: after a full run, `git status --untracked-files=all` shows only the changes already there. So the test now runs the gate on the checkout itself, as CI's gate-M3-G2 and gate-M3-partial jobs do, with the report in a temporary directory. The checks, the command's other arguments and the assertions are unchanged.
